articles.summary: Ferrovial, a leading global infrastructure company, today announced it has been selected to deliver Tennessee’s I-24 Southeast Choice Lanes in Nashville, the largest single capital investment and first public-private partnership in Tennessee’s history.
articles.title: Ferrovial selected to deliver Tennessee’s I-24 Choice Lanes
